## Purpose
The run-screen left-column composition root: it fuses the transcript panel, a unified composer, and the absorbed AgentProgressPanel controls (stop/revise/relaunch, gate quick-actions, clarify quick-actions, chain-suggestion chips) into a single conversational lane whose composer mode switches off a generic live-run state discriminator (`RunLaneState`) rather than any workflow/agent name.

## Shape
- `RunChatLane` — the exported component; owns transcript state (reply-pending spinner, reading indicator, held refinement, chain picker) and renders `ChatPanel` + a mode-driven composer.
- `RunLaneState` / `GateContext` / `LaneSuggestion` / `LaneProposal` / `RunChatLaneProps` — the generic prop/type surface the caller (DashboardLayout) threads live data through; explicitly never keyed on workflow/agent-name literals (the file's SC-001 invariant).
- `FreeTextComposer` — the mock's rounded input bar (attach/voice/send) with auto-growing textarea, speech-to-text, and an attachment tray.
- Transcript adornments — `TranscriptCard`, `ClarifyCountRow`, `PipelineMini`, `AwaitingCard`, `AnsweredNote`, `DeliverableCard`, `SettledSummaryStrip`, `RunAttachmentChips` — collapsible cards summarizing clarify counts, per-agent pipeline progress, and the delivered artifact.
- Helper functions — `matchChainTarget` (detects a "<transform> into <target>" chain phrase against live suggestions), `firstAgentError`/`sanitizeError` (surface a single sanitized failure line), `deriveSecurityBullets` (structured security-failure bullets from live pipeline state), `countClarifications`.
- `handleFreeText` — routes free-text send by `runState`: settled runs go through a Concierge classify-intent round trip (revise/chain/ask), building runs post directly as steering messages.

## Why this shape
The component absorbs what used to be several separate panels (progress panel controls, gate UI, clarify UI) into one lane so the composer surface stays singular, and it is explicitly built around a generic `runState` discriminator (documented in-file as invariant SC-001) so no branch of the UI can special-case a specific workflow or agent by name.
